'''BO-55''', also known as '''Master''', was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] of a discontinued model that was picked up by [[Ravagers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Torque (pirate)|Torque]], who rebuilt and reprogrammed him into a blood-thirsty killing machine. BO-55 eventually convinced the pirates to oversee the construction of [[Blaster (droid)|Blaster]], a jury-rigged battle droid, to serve as his companion in battle.<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Ravagers [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Coratanni]] dispatched them to take out the strike team send by her predecessor [[Ruugar]]. BO-55 and Blaster engaged the "dunderheads" on the deck of the ''[[Soaring Duros]]'', but were defeated after a prolonged fight.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
BO-55 appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
